question: Kathak dancer Birju Maharaj received India's second highest civilian honour, the Padma Vibhushan, in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1986**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kathak dancer Birju Maharaj** is one of the most renowned and legendary artists in Indian classical dance. His contributions to **Kathak** are globally recognized.
 
• Birju Maharaj received the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian honor, in **1986**. *Hence, this is the correct answer.*
